MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "American Graffiti and the Righteous Brothers collection fit my interest in melodic oldies, especially after Simon & Garfunkel and AM Gold: The Mid-'60s.",
    "The Rolling Stones and Steppenwolf hits collections offer familiar classic rock songs, matching my recent choices of classic rock compilations and greatest-hits albums."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Blue & Lonesome and Santana IV connect with my rock listening, but today I want recognizable hits rather than a blues-focused album or a later studio release.",
    "The Anita Baker collection has the compilation format I often choose, but its soul direction is less appealing to me right now than older pop and classic rock.",
    "Greatest Hits - Chapter One and Grace do not give me enough information about the artist or songs to choose them confidently."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Liking classic rock does not mean I am equally interested in every album by a familiar rock artist; the particular songs and kind of release matter.",
    "A best-of title alone is not enough to attract me when I cannot connect the music to the familiar sounds I want."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated choices of greatest-hits collections suggest that familiar songs are a stronger draw right now than exploring related artists' studio albums.",
    "The melodic oldies connection matters especially strongly: the Righteous Brothers feel closer to my Simon & Garfunkel and mid-'60s listening than a broad rock connection does.",
    "The rootsy direction of the JJ Cale tribute interests me, but that interest is weaker than my immediate preference for familiar hits."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in older music and compilations, but sometimes stretch that into related albums without enough familiar songs to make me choose them now."
}
